findings.outcome: Blue-black leathery flyer has a thorned arrowhead tail and frightens Nash/Vorel; Eye supplies bright-light guidance. Hope kills the first; another loses its head at the portal while more remain above.
findings.limits: No named species, tail venom, sleep immunity, fixed radiant vulnerability, general portal kill rule or identity with Lethanphius. Residual biting of the severed head is not established lasting life.

findings.outcome: Winged reptilian pet uses a poison sting, bites and claws; Stanley kills it with Booming Blade/Diplomacy. E058 recap explicitly calls it a wyvern.
findings.limits: Wyvern label is recap evidence, not anatomical inference. No identity with the removed skyfall body, chasm flyer, Outlands individuals or Dolo Popio; no universal poison defense or innate death explosion.
